name: comp-449

frames.best_why: Shows the full icon-led path with the home link lit and the current page brightest.

tagline: A path line where a house and a block icon lead to the current page.
summary: A flat breadcrumb row pairing a house outline with Home and a small blocks glyph with Components, before a brighter current-page label.
appearance: Three short labels sit in a row on black, the first preceded by a house outline and the second by a small blocks glyph, with faint chevrons between. The final label Breadcrumb reads brighter than the two links.
behaviour: Hovering a link lifts its text and icon from grey to white while the row stays fixed. Nothing else changes.
demo_content: Home, Components and Breadcrumb with house and block icons.
search_phrases: path trail using a house symbol
show where i am on the site
website location with icon per step
clickable path to return up a level
use_when: Showing a page's place in a short hierarchy with quick links back up the levels.
avoid_when: When the path is long: only two links plus the current page are set up here.
customise: The three labels and their icons are fixed in the file; a real path means editing the items and swapping the icon imports.
weight_why: Three text links and two small icons; no script, loop or animation.

a11y.note: Icons are hidden from screen readers and each link keeps its text name; focus styling falls back to the browser.

polish_why: Crisp spacing and a legible hierarchy, but a plain breadcrumb with icons added.
title: Breadcrumb With Icons
